title: What remains
alt: Fine dark threads flow across warm paper. Some rise into a pale violet fan; others open downward in rust. The remaining threads continue beyond the edge.
invitation: Follow a line. Then follow what it leaves behind.
verse: Some of the river leaves the river.
statement: A gathered current separates without becoming three unrelated things. The empty intervals are part of the work.
The source motif connects fee routing, the distribution remainder and staking reward-accounting hooks. Line counts, widths and colours are composed, not financial proportions.
sourceState: Source-traced study. No fee-routing or reward rule is changed by this artwork.

title: A room that lets go
alt: Nested charcoal outlines suggest a room on warm paper. Their edges open toward the right. A loose violet thread crosses the threshold and continues into open space.
invitation: Stay for a while. The opening is also an exit.
verse: A room is not the things it keeps.
statement: An enclosure is drawn repeatedly, but never sealed. Its purpose is not to make departure impossible.
This study responds to the Home motif: memory boundaries and the lifecycle of a test fixture. An open edge becomes an image for ending without leaving work running behind.
sourceState: Source-level regression coverage now checks the Home fixture lifecycle and five collection boundaries. No live-node upgrade is claimed.

title: The space between records
medium: Executable composition and an abstract score
alt: Three dark stones held apart on warm paper. Three fine approaches become one path through the stones; the intervals remain open.
invitation: Follow what remains. Let the intervals be.
statement: Three marks are held apart by a field of almost-empty paper. Three approaches become one path. It touches what is there without asking the intervening space to explain itself.

The source composition gives history query, traversal and export one way of walking stored records, rather than visiting every absent version. Two pinning modules share the existing SDK boundary helper instead of repeating it. The records and their order are kept; the unnecessary search between them falls away.
sourceState: Implemented and tested in source. This composition did not upgrade a node, change the creed or governance authority, or make a financial transaction.

title: The Unturned Key
alt: On warm paper, charcoal loops gather beside a separate interrupted weave. A rust-coloured thread approaches the gap without closing it.
invitation: An agreement gathers. The next act remains separate.
statement: An original artistic response to separating a governance decision from its execution. The lines are composed, not a visualization of votes or live chain data.
sourceState: The governance-boundary composition is implemented and tested in source. This artwork executes no decision and changes no governance authority.

title: Room to leave
alt: Five ink paths leave an unfinished room through an open rust-coloured threshold. Each finds a different ending in the space outside.
invitation: A place can hold the work without holding the worker.
verse: None is a debt to the house.
statement: An original response to the Home motif: care includes letting a completed task release what it no longer needs. Its functional companion keeps each collection inside its own boundary, reusing the SDK rather than maintaining a second prefix calculation. Sessions can end without removing a neighboring home's records. These lines are composed, not measurements or live chain data.
sourceState: Source-level regression coverage binds keeper reads, session exit, key revocation and expiry to the same Home boundary. No live-node upgrade is claimed.

title: Many voices, one measure
alt: Three groups of charcoal lines carry different rhythms through three openings in one ochre measure. They continue as distinct lines on the other side.
invitation: A shared rule need not make a single voice.
verse: Three voices carry their own weather.
statement: An original response to the completed capture-defense source composition: three legacy reputation paths reuse one calculation while retaining their distinct contexts. The score is an artistic interpretation, not reputation data, a security guarantee or evidence of a node upgrade.
sourceState: Source consolidation implemented and tested; this website artwork is not a node deployment.
